name: Golf ville
overview: Introducing Golf Ville, Dubai Hills, a unique residential community designed by the esteemed Emaar Properties. Situated amidst expansive verdant vistas and the breathtaking vistas of an elite golf course, Golf Ville provides luxurious living accommodations for those seeking peace and quiet. This exceptional project offers an unmatched lifestyle that is unmatched thanks to its prime location in Dubai Hills Estate, Hadaeq Sheikh Mohammed Bin Rashid, and its convenient access via Al Marabea' Street, Al Khail Road, and 34th Street.
